summary: Frontend-only testing of Phase 3 super-admin 'act-as-salon' + HQ Inbox. FLOW A/C/D/E PASS. FLOW B (delete blocked) reveals backend correctly returns 403 but frontend does NOT show any toast — an uncaught runtime error overlay appears instead (missing try/catch on api.delete in Services.jsx and multiple other pages).

ui_bugs.issue: Banner text renders 'Super-Admin mode — viewing salon' instead of the actual salon name (e.g., 'Miracurl Unisex Family Salon'). Root cause: in AuthContext.jsx bootstrap effect (line 50) and afterAuth (line 71), when user.role === 'super_admin' the code returns early WITHOUT fetching /tenants/current, so `tenant` stays null even in act-as mode. AppLayout passes this null tenant to ActAsBanner which falls back to the literal 'salon'.

No try/catch around `await api.delete(/services/{id})`. When super-admin in act-as mode triggers delete, backend correctly returns 403 with friendly message 'deleting is reserved for the salon owner', but frontend throws an Uncaught runtime error, shows the react-error-overlay full-screen instead of the required error toast. User expectation ('error toast containing "deleting is reserved for the salon owner"') is NOT met.

Same missing try/catch pattern (silent failure + potential runtime error on 403) exists in: Appointments.jsx:114, Staff.jsx:69, Plans.jsx:30, Assistant.jsx:146, Gallery.jsx:51, Inventory.jsx:53, Customers.jsx:58, ManagersSection.jsx:43. All these will misbehave in act-as mode when the server returns 403.

integration_issues.issue: Server returns 403 as expected (verified via network response), item not deleted, BUT no toast shown; instead react runtime error overlay covers the page. Users have no idea why the delete failed.

issues: Banner is fixed at top with z-70 (46px tall) but neither body nor the AppLayout header get a top-padding offset, so on small screens the salon header/nav is partially covered by the banner. Currently visually acceptable on desktop because layout has enough margin.

action_items: Wrap all `api.delete(...)` calls in try/catch and surface `formatApiError(err?.response?.data?.detail)` via toast.error — priority Services.jsx first (line 64-67).

Fix ActAsBanner tenant name: in AuthContext.jsx, when role === 'super_admin' AND getActAsSalon() is set, fetch /tenants/current (with X-Tenant-Slug header from setActAsSalon) so `tenant.name` is populated. Alternatively pass name from localStorage (getActAsSalon().name) directly to ActAsBanner.
Consider adding top padding (~46px) to app root when banner is visible so it never overlaps the header on mobile.
critical_code_review_comments: Services.jsx remove(): no try/catch → uncaught axios rejection escapes as react runtime error overlay. Same anti-pattern in ~8 other delete handlers.
AuthContext bootstrap returns early on super_admin without honoring act-as mode → tenant state stays null even after setActAsSalon(). Should fetch tenant when act-as is active.
Services.jsx and Inventory.jsx use native window.confirm() which is inconsistent with the shadcn AlertDialog used elsewhere (Reviews, StaffRegistry). UX inconsistency.
Console log spam: multiple 401s on the login page and repeated Recharts 'width(-1) height(-1)' warnings on /super-admin — cosmetic but noisy.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Two verified bugs remain: (1) Services.jsx (and other pages) missing try/catch around api.delete — causes runtime error overlay instead of the friendly 403 toast; (2) ActAsBanner shows 'viewing salon' because AuthContext skips tenant fetch for super_admin. Backend 403 payload contains the correct message. After main agent applies the fix, retest FLOW B end-to-end (both edit save toast and delete blocked toast). FLOW A/C/D/E already validated.
rca of the issue: Services delete failure: backend `_apply_tenant_context` correctly returns 403 with `deleting is reserved for the salon owner` (verified: network tab shows 403 response). Frontend `remove()` in Services.jsx (line 64) calls `await api.delete(...)` with no try/catch → axios rejects → uncaught in async handler → react-error-overlay pops. Fix: `try { await api.delete(...); toast.success('Deleted'); load(); } catch (err) { toast.error(formatApiError(err?.response?.data?.detail) || 'Delete failed'); }`. ActAsBanner name: AuthContext.jsx line 50 short-circuits for super_admin — must add branch: if super_admin AND getActAsSalon() → still fetch tenant (with X-Tenant-Slug header) OR read name from localStorage.
